title: Bayesian optimization reveals new insights into gold nanorod growth conditions
summary: BO-selected syntheses showed viable accelerated gold-nanorod growth at 36-40 C and high ascorbic acid, and that ascorbic acid and temperature modulate each other's undesirable effects. Methods and the first version were not checked.
